rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Trigger. Stop at Close Capture. Let the middle do the work.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Catch the thought before it becomes the room.

GAME MOVE
Start at Trigger. Stop at Close Capture. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIRST FRAME // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Trigger — A trigger flickers.
2. Pause Story — Do not explain it yet.
3. Capture Thought — Pin the first mental sentence, picture, or prediction exactly as it arrived.
4. Quote — Put quotation marks around it.
5. Close Capture — The catch ends there; no life story, no courtroom, no spiral.

⚡ FINISH — Close Capture closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Trigger, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Capture Thought, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Close Capture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Catch the thought before it becomes the room.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.safety:
PAUSE
Stop if holding the thought in mind makes you feel less steady or more upset.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

rituals.unique_game_move: Start with Imagine Trays. When Balance Verdict appears, the round is over.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Emotional reasoning

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use The Two-Tray Test when your mind keeps circling without finding anything new. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A loud conclusion still has to pass inspection.

GAME MOVE
Start with Imagine Trays. When Balance Verdict appears, the round is over.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE TWO-TRAY TEST // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

⚡ END MOVE — Balance Verdict. No second lap.

rituals.title: WORST CASE, WITH EXITS
rituals.name: WORST CASE, WITH EXITS
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.
rituals.recognition_cue: Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.situation: Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.immediate_need: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.challenge: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORST CASE, WITH EXITS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Fear, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Add Likely, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Act Now, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

📸 MY RESULT
“My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.”

rituals.plain:
WORST CASE, WITH EXITS

TRIGGER
Catastrophic prediction

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Worst Case, With Exits is for the moment when your mind has jumped straight to disaster—before the reaction gets to choose for you.

GOAL
A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Fear and keep going only until Act Now.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 WORST CASE, WITH EXITS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Name Fear — Picture the feared ending in one line.
2. Build Exits — Under it build four rungs: WHAT HAPPENS; WHAT I DO NEXT; WHO OR WHAT HELPS; HOW RECOVERY COULD BEGIN.
3. Add Likely — Add a fifth rung for the outcome that is actually most likely.
4. Climb Route — Move through the five steps once in your mind.
5. Act Now — Then take the first coping action available now.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Act Now is your cue to stop.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Name Fear, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Add Likely, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Act Now, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A worst-case story loses size when it gains a route.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can stop at Act Now instead of feeding the pattern one more lap.

📸 MY RESULT
“My mind showed me disaster; I found an exit.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Fear → Build Exits → Add Likely → Climb Route → Act Now

rituals.title: THE GREY DIAL
rituals.name: THE GREY DIAL
rituals.unique_game_move: Play from Name Extremes to Choose Response. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.recognition_cue: If your mind has turned everything into all-or-nothing, The Grey Dial turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.situation: If your mind has turned everything into all-or-nothing, The Grey Dial turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.immediate_need: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.challenge: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
If your mind has turned everything into all-or-nothing, The Grey Dial turns the mental noise into one playable move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

GAME MOVE
Play from Name Extremes to Choose Response. Treat the last move as the finish line.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE GREY DIAL // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Name Extremes — Name the two extremes your mind is using.
2. Build Scale — Build a 0–10 scale between them and say three real anchor points: 2, 5, and 8.
3. Place Today — Place today’s event where the evidence fits—not where the emotion shouts.
4. Choose Response — Choose a response matched to that exact setting.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Choose Response and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Name Extremes, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Place Today, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Choose Response, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

rituals.win_reward:
🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The pattern becomes easier to spot before you commit to Choose Response.

📸 MY RESULT
“It wasn't 0 or 10. There was a real number in between.”

rituals.unique_game_move: Let Imagine Trusted begin the game. Let Apply Page end it.
rituals.recognition_cue: Borrow Their Mirror works best when an old rule is being treated like a fact. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.situation: Borrow Their Mirror works best when an old rule is being treated like a fact. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.immediate_need: Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.
rituals.challenge: Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Rigid beliefs, labels & stories

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Borrow Their Mirror works best when an old rule is being treated like a fact. The goal is not to win an argument with your mind—just change the next move.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.

GAME MOVE
Let Imagine Trusted begin the game. Let Apply Page end it.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW THEIR MIRROR // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Trusted — Imagine a trusted person bringing you the same facts.
2. Hold In Your Mind Allowances — Hold the questions you would ask them, the allowances you would make, and the evidence you would require before judging them.
3. Remove Name — Now remove their name.
4. Apply Page — Apply that page to yourself without adding a harsher clause.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Apply Page and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Imagine Trusted: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Remove Name, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Apply Page, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.

You can choose Apply Page from what you noticed, not just from what you felt first.

📸 MY RESULT
“I found a rule I had never actually chosen.”

Play from Name Thought to Return Feeling. Treat the last move as the finish line.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE SKY DOES NOT BECOME THE WEATHER // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Name Thought — Name one thought, one feeling, and one role active now.
2. Say Being — For each, say: ‘This is being noticed.’ Search for the noticing itself—its colour, age, or mood.
3. Rest Openness — If none can be found, rest with that openness for ten seconds.
4. Return Feeling — Return by feeling both feet.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Return Feeling and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Name Thought, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Rest Openness, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Return Feeling, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Return Feeling, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just chose one move that matched what matters to me.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DOES THE FEELING FIT THE FILE? // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

rituals.unique_game_move: One round only: enter at Dont Support, finish at Match Posture.
rituals.recognition_cue: Use Reverse The Urge, Completely when the urge feels like an instruction. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.situation: Use Reverse The Urge, Completely when the urge feels like an instruction. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.immediate_need: When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use Reverse The Urge, Completely when the urge feels like an instruction. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Dont Support, finish at Match Posture.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REVERSE THE URGE, COMPLETELY // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Dont Support — Verify that the facts do not support the action impulse.
2. Speak Gently — Then perform its full safe opposite: approach instead of avoid, speak gently instead of attack, straighten instead of collapse, engage instead of hide.
3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Match Posture and release the exercise.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Dont Support, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Speak Gently, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Match Posture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

📸 MY RESULT

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET THE EMOTION FINISH ONE CHAPTER // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Identify Chapter — Spot the current chapter only: sensation, meaning, action urge, or settling.
2. Permit — Permit the next natural chapter while withholding later ones.
3. Dont Interpret — If sensation is active, do not interpret; if meaning is clear, do not act yet.
4. Continue Genuine — Continue until a genuine settling marker—breath change, warmth, tears ending, posture release—appears.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Continue Genuine and release the exercise.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 INSTALL THE CAPABLE MEMORY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Recall Real — Recall one real moment of courage, care, steadiness, or help.
2. Find Strongest — Find its strongest sensory detail and the body location that responds.

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Pick Detail first, Keep Core last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP WHERE THE DETAIL CAME FROM // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Core, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Pick Detail, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Rate Confidence, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Keep Core, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

🎮 INSTALL THE COUNTER-QUALITY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Name Active — Name the active pattern and the wholesome quality opposite with it: cruelty/kindness, panic/steadiness, greed/sufficiency.
2. Act Counter — Produce one thought, posture, and act expressing the counter-quality.
3. Keep Credible — Keep it credible rather than grand.
4. Train — Train the opposite channel through embodiment.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Train be enough.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Right before the first move, Name Active, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Keep Credible, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Train, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Do not wrestle a harmful tendency on its own ground.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can complete Train without needing perfect certainty first.

📸 MY RESULT
“My body sounded an alarm; I didn't have to turn it into danger.”

Name Active → Act Counter → Keep Credible → Train

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIVE-LAYER INSPECTION // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Move Body — Move through body, energy, mind, intellect, and deep ease.
2. Ask Change — At each layer ask what is present, what changes, and how it is known.
3. Dont Discard — Do not discard any layer.
4. Place Like — Place them like translucent sheets within awareness, then select the layer needed for practical action.

⚡ FINISH — Place Like closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Move Body, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Dont Discard, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Place Like, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

rituals.title: THE WAKING DREAM CHECK
rituals.name: THE WAKING DREAM CHECK
rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Take Event. Stop at Try Construction. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.recognition_cue: The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
rituals.situation: The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
rituals.immediate_need: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.challenge: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
Start at Take Event. Stop at Try Construction. Let the middle do the work.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE WAKING DREAM CHECK // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes.

⚡ FINISH — Try Construction closes the round.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Take Event, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Identify Facts, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Try Construction, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You arrive at Try Construction with less need to obey the first answer.

📸 MY RESULT
“I stopped measuring my whole life against one snapshot.”
rituals.formula_flow: Take Event → Compare Dream → Identify Facts → Try Construction

rituals.title: RETURN THE PROJECTION TO SENDER
rituals.name: RETURN THE PROJECTION TO SENDER
rituals.unique_game_move: Give yourself one clean run: Picture Quality first, Keep Facts last.
rituals.recognition_cue: When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Return The Projection To Sender helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.situation: When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Return The Projection To Sender helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.immediate_need: The mind may be viewing its expectation on someone else’s screen.
rituals.challenge: The mind may be viewing its expectation on someone else’s screen.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Automatic habits & autopilot

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
When the old reaction is running before you notice it, Return The Projection To Sender helps you test what your mind is telling you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The mind may be viewing its expectation on someone else’s screen.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Picture Quality first, Keep Facts last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THE PROJECTION TO SENDER // PLAY
Play the moves, not the whole life story.

1. Picture Quality — Picture the quality you are assigning outward.
2. Ask Internal — Ask what internal expectation, fear, or rule would make that quality especially visible.
3. Name External — Name the external evidence separately.
4. Keep Facts — Keep what the facts support; return the excess meaning to your own inquiry.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Facts, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Picture Quality, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Name External, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Keep Facts, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep the clean version: The mind may be viewing its expectation on someone else’s screen.

📸 MY RESULT

Use Picture Lines as the doorway and Statement as the exit.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BOX THE PROBLEM // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Picture Lines — Picture three lines: CURRENT CONDITION; DESIRED CONDITION; MEASURABLE GAP.
2. Remove History — Remove history unless it changes the gap.
3. Give Problem — Give the problem a time horizon and one owner.
4. Statement — If the statement still contains ‘everything,’ shrink it again.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Statement is your cue to stop.

🎮 THE AFTERSHOCK CLOCK // PLAY

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CAPTURE THE MODEL’S MISS // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Hold In Your Mind Versions — The moment an outcome differs from expectation, Keep both versions verbatim.
2. State Size — State the size and direction of the error.
3. Name Miss — Finish with: ‘The old model must now explain…’ and name the discrepancy.
4. Dont Rewrite — Do not let hindsight rewrite the original forecast.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Dont Rewrite be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:

1. Right before the first move, Hold In Your Mind Versions, let one breath happen without trying to improve it.
2. At Name Miss, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Dont Rewrite, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Reality’s surprise is premium evidence.

rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Evidence distortion & selective thinking

PLAY TIME
1–2 minutes

HOOK
Same Facts, Three Assumptions is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind has zoomed in so far that the rest disappeared.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Stress-test the belief by changing only its hidden premise.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Keep Observations first, Compare Action last.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SAME FACTS, THREE ASSUMPTIONS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Keep Observations — Keep all observations fixed.
2. Re — Re-run them under three different assumptions about motive, capability, or context.
3. Identify Action — For each, spot the next action it recommends.
4. Compare Action — Compare which action remains robust across versions.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Compare Action, you are done.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Keep Observations, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Identify Action, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Compare Action, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Stress-test the belief by changing only its hidden premise.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE MOVE NO FEELING MUST BETRAY // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Seat Feelings — Name up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.

⚡ END MOVE — Choose Survivor. No second lap.

4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.

⚡ END MOVE — Choose Survivor. No second lap.

Choose Survivor becomes possible without giving the reaction another full round.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 POWER THEN, RESOURCES NOW // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Imagine Two Sides — Imagine two sides.
2. Then — On the first side, picture your age, knowledge, money, power, support, and choices then.
3. Now — On the second side, picture the same things today.
4. Find The Change — Notice what gives you more choice now.
5. Use One Resource — Pick one resource you have today and use it in one small action.

⚡ DONE — Complete Use One Resource, then return to your day.

Enter through Imagine Two Sides; leave as soon as you reach Use One Resource. One pass is enough.

The old reaction loses a little speed before Use One Resource.

rituals.unique_game_move: Start at Adopt and keep going only until Hold Posture.
rituals.recognition_cue: Posture Without Prophecy is for the moment when your body position is helping the mood stay stuck—before the reaction gets to choose for you.

rituals.immediate_need: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.challenge: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Panic & body alarm

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
Posture Without Prophecy is for the moment when your body position is helping the mood stay stuck—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.

GAME MOVE
Start at Adopt and keep going only until Hold Posture.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 POSTURE WITHOUT PROPHECY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Adopt — Adopt a stable, non-defensive position: feet supported, spine available, gaze level, arms unguarded enough for safety. clearly refuse both positive and negative…
2. Hold Posture — Hold the posture while waiting for actual evidence.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Hold Posture is your cue to stop.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. As you enter Adopt, feel where your body is supported for one moment.
2. At Hold Posture, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Hold Posture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: The body can stop rehearsing defeat before facts arrive.

📸 MY RESULT
“A small body shift changed the way the moment felt.”

Touch Check Temperature, follow the moves, and finish on Let Readings.

Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

The exercise gives you enough room to make Let Readings intentional.

“I found the room again through my senses.”

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE THE VALUE TO A NEW VESSEL // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MAKE THE ORDINARY WORTHY OF FULL CONTACT // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Choose Routine — Choose one routine act—making tea, bathing, preparing a child’s bag, opening work.
2. Perform — Perform it without rushing or secondary media.
3. Craft — Notice craft, dependence, and life supported by the act.
4. Finish Deserved — Finish as if it deserved completion.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Finish Deserved be enough.
rituals.potency_stack:

2. At Craft, ask, “What can I do in under two minutes?”.
3. When you reach Finish Deserved, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Sacredness can be an attention quality, not an exceptional event.

rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PLAY EMOTION JENGA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack closes the round.

1. Before you begin Name Stack, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.

3. When you reach Rebuild Stack, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OPEN THREE ENDING ROOMS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Identify Critical — Spot the critical decision point in the dominant future scene.
2. Create Endings — Create three endings by changing the choice there: cautious, courageous, and collaborative.
3. Cost — Notice the cost and value of each.
4. Keep Best — Keep the ending that best fits evidence and values.

⚡ DONE — Complete Keep Best, then return to your day.

TRIGGER
Values, meaning & loss

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
When the immediate feeling has pulled you away from what matters, try Open Three Ending Rooms. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.

GOAL
The future should not be rehearsed as a single locked corridor.

GAME MOVE
Enter through Identify Critical; leave as soon as you reach Keep Best. One pass is enough.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 OPEN THREE ENDING ROOMS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Identify Critical — Spot the critical decision point in the dominant future scene.
2. Create Endings — Create three endings by changing the choice there: cautious, courageous, and collaborative.
3. Cost — Notice the cost and value of each.
4. Keep Best — Keep the ending that best fits evidence and values.

⚡ DONE — Complete Keep Best, then return to your day.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. At the start of Identify Critical, widen your gaze and notice the edges of the room.
2. At Cost, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Keep Best, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: The future should not be rehearsed as a single locked corridor.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The exercise gives you enough room to make Keep Best intentional.

📸 MY RESULT
“I chose one move that matched what matters to me.”

FORMULA FLOW
Identify Critical → Create Endings → Cost → Keep Best

rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Frequency cannot settle an ethical question.

GAME MOVE
Move through the sequence once, from State Social to Keep Modify.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COMMON IS NOT THE SAME AS RIGHT // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. State Social — State the social norm and your chosen criteria—harm, fairness, consent, dignity, responsibility.
2. Evaluate — Check the norm against each criterion without citing popularity.
3. Keep Modify — Keep, modify, or reject it based on the ethical comparison.

⚡ FINISH — Keep Modify closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin State Social, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Evaluate, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Keep Modify, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Frequency cannot settle an ethical question.

rituals.unique_game_move: Begin with Identify Whose. Move straight through to Keep Repair—no extra analysing.
rituals.recognition_cue: Return The Shame To Its Old Address is for the moment when one painful thing is becoming a verdict about your whole self—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.situation: Return The Shame To Its Old Address is for the moment when one painful thing is becoming a verdict about your whole self—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.immediate_need: A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.
rituals.challenge: A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.
rituals.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Self-blame, guilt & shame

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Return The Shame To Its Old Address is for the moment when one painful thing is becoming a verdict about your whole self—before the reaction gets to choose for you.
rituals.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.

GAME MOVE
Begin with Identify Whose. Move straight through to Keep Repair—no extra analysing.
rituals.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 RETURN THE SHAME TO ITS OLD ADDRESS // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Identify Whose — Spot whose rule the shame is enforcing and the setting where it was learned.
2. Ask Whether — Ask whether you still endorse that standard.
3. Keep Repair — Keep any ethical repair that is truly yours; return contempt, prejudice, or impossible expectation to its source.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Keep Repair and leave the game there.
rituals.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Identify Whose: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Ask Whether, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Keep Repair, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: A judging context can end while its standard keeps living inside you.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Keep Repair and leave the game there.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE TWO-TRAY TEST // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Imagine Trays — Imagine two trays.
2. Name Sides — Name the left SUPPORTS IT and the right DOESN’T FIT.
3. Sort Facts — Drop only visible facts into them—no feelings disguised as evidence.
4. Switch Sides — Now cover the fuller tray and read the neglected one aloud.
5. Balance Verdict — Finish with a verdict that can hold both sides without pretending they weigh the same.

⚡ END MOVE — Balance Verdict. No second lap.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

GAME MOVE
Play from Name Extremes to Choose Response. Treat the last move as the finish line.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE GREY DIAL // PLAY
Play it once. No bonus analysis.

1. Name Extremes — Name the two extremes your mind is using.
2. Build Scale — Build a 0–10 scale between them and say three real anchor points: 2, 5, and 8.
3. Place Today — Place today’s event where the evidence fits—not where the emotion shouts.
4. Choose Response — Choose a response matched to that exact setting.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Choose Response and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Name Extremes, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Place Today, look for the piece of evidence your first reaction ignored.
3. When you reach Choose Response, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Use this as the exit rule: Binary thinking hates a numbered dial.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.

GAME MOVE
Let Imagine Trusted begin the game. Let Apply Page end it.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BORROW THEIR MIRROR // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Imagine Trusted — Imagine a trusted person bringing you the same facts.
2. Hold In Your Mind Allowances — Hold the questions you would ask them, the allowances you would make, and the evidence you would require before judging them.
3. Remove Name — Now remove their name.
4. Apply Page — Apply that page to yourself without adding a harsher clause.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Apply Page and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:

1. Give yourself one second before Imagine Trusted: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Remove Name, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Apply Page, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Leave the exercise with this: Use the standard you reserve for someone you respect.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE RULE UNDER THE RULE // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Picture Painful — Picture the painful thought.
2. Ask Meaning — Ask, ‘If that were true, what would it mean about me, others, or life?’ Answer quickly, then ask the same question of the answer.
3. Continue Stable — Continue only until one stable rule repeats.
4. Box — Box that rule.
5. Today — Today’s task is to inspect it, not obey it.

⚡ FINISH — Today closes the round.

Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.

GAME MOVE
Play from Name Thought to Return Feeling. Treat the last move as the finish line.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE SKY DOES NOT BECOME THE WEATHER // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Name Thought — Name one thought, one feeling, and one role active now.
2. Say Being — For each, say: ‘This is being noticed.’ Search for the noticing itself—its colour, age, or mood.
3. Rest Openness — If none can be found, rest with that openness for ten seconds.
4. Return Feeling — Return by feeling both feet.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Return Feeling and release the exercise.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Name Thought, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Rest Openness, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Return Feeling, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: Content changes; the capacity to notice keeps showing up.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
At Return Feeling, the next move feels chosen rather than dictated.

📸 MY RESULT
“I just chose one move that matched what matters to me.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Thought → Say Being → Rest Openness → Return Feeling

GOAL

GAME MOVE

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 UPGRADE THE WAITING ROOM // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Pick Best — Pick the best lever for this interval: picture a supportive scene, connect the moment to meaning, offer a brief prayer, relax one area, do one thing fully, or speak…
2. Use Lever — Use only one lever until the interval ends.
3. Improving — You are improving the room, not denying why you are there.

⚡ END MOVE — Improving. No second lap.
items.potency_stack:

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 DOES THE FEELING FIT THE FILE? // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Separate Cards — Separate four cards: prompting event, meaning, verified evidence, actual present threat.
2. Compare Emotion — Compare the emotion’s intensity and duration with the fourth card.
3. Use Feeling — If they fit, use the feeling’s message.
4. Update Meaning — If they exceed it, regulate first and update the meaning.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Update Meaning be enough.

PLAY TIME
about 1 minute

HOOK
Use Reverse The Urge, Completely when the urge feels like an instruction. It turns the reaction into a small experiment.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

GAME MOVE
One round only: enter at Dont Support, finish at Match Posture.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 REVERSE THE URGE, COMPLETELY // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Dont Support — Verify that the facts do not support the action impulse.
2. Speak Gently — Then perform its full safe opposite: approach instead of avoid, speak gently instead of attack, straighten instead of collapse, engage instead of hide.
3. Match Posture — Match posture, words, and behaviour until the new signal is coherent.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Match Posture and release the exercise.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. To open Dont Support, slow the next movement by about half.
2. At Speak Gently, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Match Posture, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Take this line with you: When the emotion is unjustified, half-opposites do not retrain it.

📸 MY RESULT

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Interrupted feelings keep restarting the book.

GAME MOVE
Play from Identify Chapter to Continue Genuine. Treat the last move as the finish line.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 LET THE EMOTION FINISH ONE CHAPTER // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Identify Chapter — Spot the current chapter only: sensation, meaning, action urge, or settling.
2. Permit — Permit the next natural chapter while withholding later ones.
3. Dont Interpret — If sensation is active, do not interpret; if meaning is clear, do not act yet.
4. Continue Genuine — Continue until a genuine settling marker—breath change, warmth, tears ending, posture release—appears.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Continue Genuine and release the exercise.

Play from Identify Chapter to Continue Genuine. Treat the last move as the finish line.

🎮 LET THE EMOTION FINISH ONE CHAPTER // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

3. Dont Interpret — If sensation is active, do not interpret; if meaning is clear, do not act yet.
4. Continue Genuine — Continue until a genuine settling marker—breath change, warmth, tears ending, posture release—appears.

⚡ LAST MOVE — Reach Continue Genuine and release the exercise.

1. To open Identify Chapter, slow the next movement by about half.

By the time you reach Continue Genuine, the problem looks a little more workable.

“I just had an urge. I didn't have to become it.”

🎮 INSTALL THE CAPABLE MEMORY // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Recall Real — Recall one real moment of courage, care, steadiness, or help.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Pick Detail first, Keep Core last.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP WHERE THE DETAIL CAME FROM // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Core, you are done.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. When you arrive at Pick Detail, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Rate Confidence, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Keep Core, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

items.text_plain:

TRIGGER
Uncertainty & reassurance seeking

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK
When not knowing feels like something you must fix immediately, try Stamp Where The Detail Came From. It makes the pattern easier to see and harder to obey.

GOAL
A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

GAME MOVE
Give yourself one clean run: Pick Detail first, Keep Core last.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 STAMP WHERE THE DETAIL CAME FROM // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Pick Detail — Choose one small memory detail; do not replay the event.
2. Tag Source — Stamp it SENSED, INFERRED, LEARNED LATER, or UNSURE.
3. Rate Confidence — Give the detail a confidence word—high, medium, low, or unknown—based on its source rather than its emotional intensity.
4. Keep Core — Picture one core fact that remains reliable and let the other detail keep its honest uncertainty.

⚡ STOP POINT — Once you reach Keep Core, you are done.

1. When you arrive at Pick Detail, press both feet down for three seconds.
2. At Rate Confidence, try the opposite possibility for ten seconds.
3. When you reach Keep Core, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Remember the point: A memory matters without every detail carrying equal certainty.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
The move at Keep Core feels more deliberate than automatic.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 ERASE THE OBJECT, KEEP THE CONTACT // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Stabilise — Stabilise attention on one simple form.
2. Remove Name — Gradually remove its name, meaning, shape, and boundary in that order.
3. Attend Object — Preserve the ongoing sense of attending as the object loses definition.
4. Rest Briefly — Rest briefly with contact that no longer depends on a clear thing.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Rest Briefly and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Stabilise: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Attend Object, separate responsibility from punishment.
3. When you reach Rest Briefly, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Let focus outlive its original target.

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Sense of ‘I’ has an entrance point.

GAME MOVE
Begin with Experience. Move straight through to Task—no extra analysing.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE FIRST ‘I’ // PLAY
One pass is enough. Follow what is written.

1. Experience — Notice an experience before describing it.
2. Wait Moment — Wait for the moment ‘I,’ ‘mine,’ or ‘about me’ attaches.
3. Trace Addition — Trace that addition to a body sensation, image, or location.
4. Observe Attachment — Observe the attachment without removing it.
5. Task — The task is detection, not metaphysical victory.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Task and leave the game there.
items.potency_stack:

2. At Trace Addition, name the sensation in plain physical words—pressure, heat, tightness, movement.
3. When you reach Task, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Let this be the line you keep: Sense of ‘I’ has an entrance point.

items.name: THE FIVE-LAYER INSPECTION
items.unique_game_move: Start at Move Body. Stop at Place Like. Let the middle do the work.
items.recognition_cue: When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The Five-Layer Inspection gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
items.situation: When your mind keeps circling without finding anything new, The Five-Layer Inspection gives you something concrete to do with the moment.
items.immediate_need: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.
items.challenge: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

TRIGGER
Body-state misreading

PLAY TIME
about 90 seconds

HOOK

items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

GAME MOVE
Start at Move Body. Stop at Place Like. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE FIVE-LAYER INSPECTION // PLAY
One clean round. Keep the moves simple.

1. Move Body — Move through body, energy, mind, intellect, and deep ease.
2. Ask Change — At each layer ask what is present, what changes, and how it is known.
3. Dont Discard — Do not discard any layer.
4. Place Like — Place them like translucent sheets within awareness, then select the layer needed for practical action.

⚡ FINISH — Place Like closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Move Body, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Dont Discard, move your attention to one thing that is happening now.
3. When you reach Place Like, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Carry this rule with you: Identity may be wearing several visible coats.

📸 MY RESULT

items.name: THE WAKING DREAM CHECK
items.unique_game_move: Start at Take Event. Stop at Try Construction. Let the middle do the work.
items.recognition_cue: The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
items.situation: The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
items.immediate_need: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
items.challenge: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.
items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Comparison & rejection

PLAY TIME
30–60 seconds

HOOK
The Waking Dream Check catches the moment when someone else's life has become the ruler for yours and gives you another route.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

GAME MOVE
Start at Take Event. Stop at Try Construction. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE WAKING DREAM CHECK // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Take Event — Take one rigid reading of an event.
2. Compare Dream — Compare it with a dream: both organise fragments into a convincing world.
3. Identify Facts — Spot which facts are raw and which connections were constructed.
4. Try Construction — Try one alternate construction and observe how lived experience changes.

⚡ FINISH — Try Construction closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Take Event, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Identify Facts, replace “definitely” with an honest percentage.
3. When you reach Try Construction, choose one action that fits the facts you found. If you remember one thing, make it this: Meaning builds worlds more quickly than we notice.

📸 MY RESULT

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CHANGE ONE LENS, WATCH THE WORLD // PLAY
Do the moves once and let the result be whatever it is.

1. Choose Event — Choose a current event and Picture the lens being used.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 BOX THE PROBLEM // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Picture Lines — Picture three lines: CURRENT CONDITION; DESIRED CONDITION; MEASURABLE GAP.
2. Remove History — Remove history unless it changes the gap.
3. Give Problem — Give the problem a time horizon and one owner.
4. Statement — If the statement still contains ‘everything,’ shrink it again.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Statement is your cue to stop.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THE AFTERSHOCK CLOCK // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Set Reasonable — Set a reasonable after-event window during which shakiness, replay, fatigue, or emotion are expected echoes.
2. Picture Time — Picture its end time.
3. Hold In Your Mind Sensations — Until then, Keep sensations but forbid them from changing your meaning of what happened.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Reassess and leave the game there.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 CAPTURE THE MODEL’S MISS // PLAY
One short round. Nothing to solve beyond the moves.

1. Hold In Your Mind Versions — The moment an outcome differs from expectation, Keep both versions verbatim.
2. State Size — State the size and direction of the error.
3. Name Miss — Finish with: ‘The old model must now explain…’ and name the discrepancy.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Dont Rewrite be enough.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 SAME FACTS, THREE ASSUMPTIONS // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Keep Observations — Keep all observations fixed.
2. Re — Re-run them under three different assumptions about motive, capability, or context.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 KEEP THE THREAT, ADD THE PERIPHERY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Hold Trigger — Hold the trigger at a tolerable centre.
2. Look Away — Without looking away, name five simultaneous peripheral details—colour, distance, movement, light, geometry.
3. Let Central — Let central and surrounding information coexist until the scene feels larger than the alarm.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Let Central and leave the game there.

2. At Look Away, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Let Central, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Danger loses monopoly when neutral data re-enters vision.

🎮 KEEP THE THREAT, ADD THE PERIPHERY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Hold Trigger — Hold the trigger at a tolerable centre.
2. Look Away — Without looking away, name five simultaneous peripheral details—colour, distance, movement, light, geometry.
3. Let Central — Let central and surrounding information coexist until the scene feels larger than the alarm.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Let Central and leave the game there.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Give yourself one second before Hold Trigger: soften your jaw and unclench your hands.
2. At Look Away, find one fact that does not fit the loudest story.
3. When you reach Let Central, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The round ends on this idea: Danger loses monopoly when neutral data re-enters vision.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can get from Hold Trigger to Let Central without adding another story on top.

📸 MY RESULT
“I widened the frame and found what the tunnel had hidden.”

FORMULA FLOW
Hold Trigger → Look Away → Let Central

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 MOVE NOVELTY TO THE RIGHT TEAM // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Identify Novelty — Spot the novelty source pulling attention away.
2. Add Controlled — Add controlled variety to the desired task instead: change order, tool, location, soundtrack, colour, or challenge.
3. Keep Goal — Keep the goal constant while refreshing the route.

⚡ CLOSE — Let Keep Goal be enough.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PIN A RETURN ADDRESS // PLAY
Stay with the sequence. You do not need to improve it.

1. Name Object — Name the exact OBJECT currently carrying the task: document, pan, form, email, shelf, or tool.
2. Place — Notice the precise LOCATION inside it: paragraph three, top-left field, second burner, or blue tab.
3. Choose Verb — Choose one NEXT VERB for that location: compare, type, turn, check, send, or place.
4. Reenter — After the interruption, say the three-part address once and act on the verb without rescanning the entire task.

⚡ EXIT — Finish Reenter and leave the game there.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 FIND THE MOVE NO FEELING MUST BETRAY // PLAY
Follow the sequence once; leave the rest alone.

1. Seat Feelings — Name up to three active emotions as players at the table. Leave them unnamed for the moment; observe first.
2. Vetoes — Give each emotion one veto: ‘Fear will not accept ___. Anger will not accept ___. Sadness will not accept ___.’
3. Clear Board — Cross out actions blocked by any safe, reasonable veto. Ignore demands for harm, punishment, or impossible certainty.
4. Choose Survivor — Choose one remaining action that crosses no red line, even if no feeling loves it.

⚡ END MOVE — Choose Survivor. No second lap.

items.hook: Power Then, Resources Now is a tiny mind game for the moment when your mind keeps delaying the first move.
items.mission: Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.
items.game_move: Enter through Imagine Two Sides; leave as soon as you reach Use One Resource. One pass is enough.
items.how_to_play:
🎮 POWER THEN, RESOURCES NOW // PLAY
Run the game exactly once, lightly.

1. Imagine Two Sides — Imagine two sides.
2. Then — On the first side, picture your age, knowledge, money, power, support, and choices then.
3. Now — On the second side, picture the same things today.
4. Find The Change — Notice what gives you more choice now.
5. Use One Resource — Pick one resource you have today and use it in one small action.

⚡ DONE — Complete Use One Resource, then return to your day.

items.power_up_3: When you reach Use One Resource, choose one action that fits the facts you found. Keep only this lesson: Past helplessness should not inherit present equipment.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 POSTURE WITHOUT PROPHECY // PLAY
Keep it literal. One round, then out.

1. Adopt — Adopt a stable, non-defensive position: feet supported, spine available, gaze level, arms unguarded enough for safety. clearly refuse both positive and negative…
2. Hold Posture — Hold the posture while waiting for actual evidence.

⚡ EXIT MOVE — Hold Posture is your cue to stop.

items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 THREE TEMPERATURE FACTS // PLAY
Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Check Temperature — Check temperature at three locations: hands, face, and where clothing meets skin.
2. Use Comparative — Use comparative language—cooler, warmer, neutral—rather than guessing degrees.
3. Let Readings — Let the three readings define the body’s current climate.

⚡ DONE — Complete Let Readings, then return to your day.

🎮 SCENT THE RETURN // PLAY

items.trigger_play_time:
TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Play Emotion Jenga gives you a quick reset for the moment when the urge feels like an instruction.
items.goal_why_game_move:
GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Stack. Stop at Rebuild Stack. Let the middle do the work.
items.play_the_loop:
HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PLAY EMOTION JENGA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack closes the round.
items.potency_stack:
⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Name Stack, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Check Remainder, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Rebuild Stack, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

📸 MY RESULT

items.formula_flow: Name Stack → Pull One → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack

PAUSE
Stop if the game causes numbness, feeling unreal or disconnected, suppression, or pressure to erase a valid feeling.

This is a self-help exercise, not emergency or medical care.

items.plain:
PLAY EMOTION JENGA

TRIGGER
Urges, impulses & cravings

PLAY TIME
under 2 minutes

HOOK
Play Emotion Jenga gives you a quick reset for the moment when the urge feels like an instruction.

GOAL
Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

GAME MOVE
Start at Name Stack. Stop at Rebuild Stack. Let the middle do the work.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 PLAY EMOTION JENGA // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.

1. Name Stack — Name two or three feelings and place each on a separate mental or your imagination block.
2. Pull One — Temporarily bracket one block with the phrase ‘not deleted—just outside this test.’
3. Check Remainder — Notice what changes in the remainder: body location, urge, story, intensity, or nothing at all. Keep one difference.
4. Rebuild Stack — Restore the removed block. Repeat only if useful, then rebuild the complete stack before finishing.

⚡ FINISH — Rebuild Stack closes the round.

⚡ POWER-UPS
1. Before you begin Name Stack, let your shoulders drop and take one easy exhale.
2. At Check Remainder, give the feeling a name without letting it make the decision.
3. When you reach Rebuild Stack, choose one action that fits the facts you found. The useful rule here is simple: Pull one feeling from the stack and see what is actually holding.

🏆 WIN SIGNAL
You can hold the discomfort and still make the move at Rebuild Stack.

📸 MY RESULT
“I had an urge. I didn't have to become it.”

FORMULA FLOW
Name Stack → Pull One → Check Remainder → Rebuild Stack

Keep this round small: just the listed moves.

1. Identify Critical — Spot the critical decision point in the dominant future scene.

HOW TO PLAY
🎮 COMMON IS NOT THE SAME AS RIGHT // PLAY
Treat it like a mini experiment—one run, then stop.
